column3: “A thief comes” is rendered “The thief enters in,” and “in the street” “outside.”
“Say to their heart” is rendered “consider in their hearts,” and “surrounded them” “are all around them.”
“Burning from a baker” is rendered “heated by the baker”; NASB supplies “the fire.”
“Fever from wine” is rendered “the heat of wine,” and “scorners” “scoffers.”

“They have brought near … in their ambush” is rendered “As they approach their plotting”; “their baker is sleeping” is rendered “Their anger smolders,” reading a different word. The meaning is uncertain.
“Devour” is rendered “consume”; NASB omits “among them” in “None of them calls on Me.”
“Peoples” is rendered “nations,” and “a bread cake” “a cake.”
“Sneaked in” is rendered “are sprinkled”; NASB adds “it.”
“In its face” is rendered “against him”; NASB adds “Though.”
“There is no heart” is rendered “without sense.”
“According to a report to their assembly” is rendered “in accordance with the proclamation to their assembly.” The meaning is uncertain.
“Fled” is rendered “strayed,” “devastation” “Destruction,” and “transgressed” “rebelled”; “I will redeem” is rendered “I would redeem.”
“On grain” is rendered “For the sake of grain,” and “turn aside against” “turn away from.”
“Not height” is rendered “not upward,” “a bow of slackness” “a deceitful bow,” and “leaders” “princes.”
